note: Phase C Plan Lock created before implementation.

plan.change: Remediate adversarial audit Phase C: trusted mechanical evidence and checker provenance
expectedChanges: Replace free-form static PASS evidence with runner-measured mechanical evidence
Separate human attestation from mechanical evidence and bind each attestation to the observed SHA
Record trusted OS source SHA, clean snapshot, checker/rule digests, target commit/tree, command IDs and exit codes
Require verification to run from the trusted base OS version and reject candidate/self-modified checker provenance
Extend the base-owned PR gate to run trusted mechanical evidence when the trusted base supports it
hqDecisions: Mechanical evidence is machine-generated; human observation remains attestation rather than pretending to be machine proof
The trusted OS version for a change is the locked Plan baseSha
OS updates are checked by the previous trusted gate and become the trusted runner only for subsequent changes
Do not add signatures, video proof, or a permanent evidence database
plan.manualCheckExemptionReason: No town/runtime UI or asset behavior changes; this is Change OS infrastructure and will receive post-merge canary verification.
plan.rollback: Revert the Phase C staging PR. Production is untouched.
outOfScope: Stale same-path write protection and semantic diff templates F10/F11
unverified: GitHub-level required-check enforcement remains a repository settings concern outside this code change.
plan.problem: v0.2 still accepts arbitrary text as static/manual evidence, and local verification can run from a dirty or self-modified checker/rule checkout.
plan.currentContract: Plan identity, repository, Scope, Risk and Impact are gated, but Verification Record pass evidence is free-form and checker/rule provenance is not bound to the trusted base OS snapshot.
plan.whyExistingIsInsufficient: The adversarial audit reproduced VERIFIED with tests that never ran and with dirty local Rule files that weakened validation without appearing in the target diff.
plan.design: Introduce a trusted mechanical evidence runner and provenance utility executed from the locked base OS checkout. Static check IDs resolve through a trusted registry, runner output captures target SHA/tree, command IDs, exit codes, output digests and CI references, and Verification v0.3 accepts mechanical reports plus SHA-bound human attestations instead of free-form static PASS strings.
alternativesRejected: Keep free-form evidence strings and rely on convention
Require video or cryptographic signatures for every manual check
Run verification using the candidate branch checker/rules
Store all evidence in a permanent central database
plan.migration: v0.1/v0.2 records remain historical. Trusted v0.3 VERIFIED requires a mechanical evidence report and v0.3 human attestation shape. Existing Plan v0.2 remains the locked plan format for this phase.
plan.compatibility: Town runtime and production behavior do not change. The Change OS tooling and verification contract become stricter.
boundaryCases: static evidence says PASS but no runner execution exists
runner target SHA differs from verifiedSha
runner uses a checker/rule checkout whose HEAD differs from baseSha
trusted checkout contains dirty tracked or untracked files
manual attestation points to a different SHA
manual attestation is recorded by AI but performedBy/attestationRef are absent
unknown static check ID is requested
testPlan: Preserve existing Change Operations regression suite
Add tests for clean/digest provenance and dirty trusted checkout rejection
Add tests for measured command exit/output evidence and unknown static check rejection
Add tests proving arbitrary static evidence strings no longer satisfy Verification
Add tests for SHA-bound human attestation and provenance mismatch
plan.promotionRisk: Staging-only Change OS update. Final trusted-runner behavior must be canary-tested from the next PR after merge because the current base does not yet contain Phase C runner code.
